notes: Instrumented diagnostics, not production speed/latency qualification. Warmups are included in whole-trace phase tables.
Per-case geometry selects prefill submissions after the active request began decode and before it released. Native overlap is independently required by the HTTP harness.
ANE queued jobs are associated by queue timestamp inside a runtime.prefill_submit host span. Ready/report spans include callback delay, not hardware ANE timestamps.
Whole-trace ANE jobs can belong to warmups, initial prefill or commands after the active decode ended. Configured ANE availability is not evidence of contended ANE execution.
Full trace archives preserve original bytes, including all GPU segments, host scopes and opaque numeric metadata; no prompts or token text.
